title: Define XP-vs-milestone advancement policy per campaign/rules binding
description: Define and persist the advancement mode (XP-threshold vs milestone) bound to a campaign/rules pack. XP thresholds are sourced from the frozen pack: the SRD ships a 'table:character-advancement' record (XP-per-level) in rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1 — resolve thresholds from that canonical record rather than hardcoding or overlaying them. Provide a policy object consumed by eligibility (.7) and award (.6) logic. Depends on the design note and progression state/authority decisions.
acceptance_criteria:
- Advancement mode (XP-threshold vs milestone) is selectable and persisted per campaign/rules pack.
- XP thresholds are resolved by reading the frozen pack's 'table:character-advancement' record (no hardcoded/overlay thresholds).
- Tests prove the Character Advancement table is located in the pack AND that level -> XP-threshold mapping is deterministic and correct — threshold lookup is not shipped as untested glue.
- Policy object is consumed by eligibility (.7) and award (.6) logic; tests cover both modes.

Added thaw note docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/thaw-notes/2026-06-27-strip-control-bytes-importer.md (mirrors 2026-06-23 biome-lint-hygiene precedent). Neither file is hash-pinned in freeze-manifest.json, so no manifest update needed; both freeze checks now pass (changed-path PASSED with thaw note, hash 13/13). Changes are cosmetic control-byte hygiene with no record/output change.
close_reason: Merged via PR #337. XP-vs-milestone advancement policy: rules/advancementTable.ts resolves thresholds from the pack's table:character-advancement record (no hardcoding, fail-closed); state/advancementPolicy.ts binds mode+table to the campaign rules binding (fails closed for non-D&D XP). Includes reviewer-requested hidden-Unicode C0/DELETE guard hardening + thaw-noted control-byte cleanup in frozen importer files.
